summary: Lightning strike at about 12,400 feet on Denney Creek near Mount Yale killed Kathleen Bartlett, 31; her husband was critically injured and two nearby hikers suffered minor injuries and walked out
notes: Details per a Denver Post report dated July 20, 2015, cited in the regional news roundup. Responding agencies not named in the opened source.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount Yale)
